summary: A single native NinjaScript bridge (AddOn) running inside NinjaTrader 8, exposing a loopback-only IPC to the Python organism, is the narrowest OFFICIALLY-SUPPORTED architecture that satisfies the full organism data+execution contract. It is the one surface that can deliver completed 1-minute OHLCV bars, historical warm-up bars, real volume, exact instrument metadata, and asynchronous account/order/execution/position events, while also accepting order commands to Sim101 in a later authorized mission.
organism_contract_required: completed 1-minute OHLCV bars (event-driven, not polled last price)
exact instrument metadata (tick size, point value, expiry, currency)
order + execution + position events for reconciliation

A_ati_managed_dll.python_binding_concern: Requires pythonnet to load a .NET Framework 4.8 assembly. pythonnet is NOT installed and interpreter is Python 3.14.5 (wheel availability uncertain).
A_ati_managed_dll.verdict: REJECTED as primary — insufficient for the market-data contract; adds a second fragile surface plus a pythonnet dependency. Its account/order capabilities are fully covered by the NinjaScript bridge, so it is not needed even as a hybrid partner.

concerns: race conditions on transient file deletion
B_ati_file_interface.verdict: REJECTED — fragile and incomplete; unsuitable for production-grade simulation testing.

C_native_ninjascript_bridge.form: NinjaScript AddOn hosting a loopback TCP (127.0.0.1) server speaking the project IPC envelope
provides: BarsRequest historical + OnBarUpdate completed realtime bars with volume
Account / Order / Execution / Position objects and their event streams
order submission to Sim101 (deferred to a later authorized mission)
concerns: must be authored in C# NinjaScript and imported/compiled by Maurice inside NT8
requires NT8 to have been launched at least once
C_native_ninjascript_bridge.verdict: SELECTED — one authoritative, event-driven surface; one reconciliation point; one forensic journal; pure-Python socket client (no pythonnet).

D_official_trader_api.concern: NinjaTrader's cloud/brokerage Trader API is entitlement-gated (NinjaTrader Brokerage) and not appropriate for a local Sim101 desktop workflow; risks external dependency/cost.
D_official_trader_api.verdict: REJECTED — not available/appropriate for this free local Sim101 setup; would introduce external dependency.

python_side.market_data: src/integrations/ninjatrader/market_data_provider.py (BaseDataProvider) fed by BAR_CLOSED / HISTORICAL_BARS_RESPONSE envelopes via the bridge client; bars pass bar_gatekeeper invariants before reaching snapshot_builder.
python_side.execution: src/integrations/ninjatrader/execution_adapter.py (BrokerAdapter) — disarmed by default; translates authorized intents to ORDER_SUBMIT_REQUEST; enforces Sim101 + MNQ + qty<=1 defense-in-depth; never originates or resizes trades.
python_side.ipc: src/integrations/ninjatrader/ipc_protocol.py — envelope schema + validation (version, account, instrument, sequence, staleness, idempotency).

ninjascript_side.bridge_source: integrations/ninjatrader/ninjascript/MNQBridge.cs (delivered as source; Maurice imports into NT8 Documents\NinjaTrader 8\bin\Custom\AddOns).
ninjascript_side.binds: 127.0.0.1 loopback only; no external network exposure.

prerequisites_before_live_proof: Launch NT8 once (initialize user-data dir + create Sim101)
Log into a sim data connection
Confirm Sim101, exact MNQ expiry, and a healthy quote/bar path
why_not_easiest: The file interface (B) is easiest to code but was rejected for fragility. The bridge (C) was selected because existence, authority, wiring, reliability, and observability can each be proven — not because it is convenient.
